messages:
olivia: Heads-up — noticed a repeating pattern in eu-west dedicated pools this morning: sporadic egress 'ghosting' where tenants hit packable bandwidth but packets seem delayed/dropped for ~30s bursts. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/egress?range=1h
raj: Ugh, saw higher tail latency around 08:12 UTC too. Is this the same phenomenon as last month's soft-quarantine or something new?
olivia: Different signal — last month was NVMe I/O. This looks like nic tx-queue backpressure + route flap to the external egress proxy. net metrics show tx_q_len spike and flow entries being reprogrammed.
ben: Any pcap/logs? can we confirm packet drops vs reorder?
olivia: Grabbed tcpdump on one host: "drop:3.7%" over 45s window, retransmits up 12x. sample logs:
```
[08:12:03] nic0 tx_q_len=1024 -> 4096
[08:12:05] route: egress-proxy-14 flapped -> fallback route
[08:12:08] tcp_retransmits += 47
```
mina: That route flap smell could be our soft-routing fallback kicking in when a busy tenant saturates one AZ path. Are the affected tenants colocated on the same slice?
olivia: Yes — two high-throughput tenants in the same fractional slice. They were on shared egress VLAN with a dedicated GPU carveout. Seems "dedicated compute != dedicated egress".
sam: So isolation gap: we reserve GPUs but not egress lane. Cost vs isolation tradeoff. Options: 1) carve egress per-dedicated-slice (expensive), 2) add egress QoS policing at pool boundary (cheaper), 3) route diversity + guard rails (mid cost).
raj: My vote is (2) + (3) short term. Implement per-slice policing to limit burst to sane rates, and shift heavy tenants to diverse egress paths to avoid single-proxy choke.
ben: Agree. We should also add a probe that detects path flap + tx_q spike and triggers proactive soft-drain of the noisy tenant for 60s so others stay healthy.
olivia: Created INF-7821 for investigation and mitigation plan: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-7821 — assigned to @raj. Action items: set temporary policing (rate-limit=500Mbps) on affected slice, enable path-flap alert, schedule targeted migration for the two tenants.
eng-sre-bot: auto: alert created INF-7821 assigned raj; paging on next flap >30s
mina: Quick note: per-slice policing will increase egress cost by ~12% if applied cluster-wide. We should scope to affected AZs first. Also update docs about "dedicated compute != dedicated egress" so sales/CS know the limitation.
sam: I'll draft a short blurb for docs and coordinate with CS. Raj — can you add the probe and temp-rate rule in the runbook? a small config diff + canary rollout will do.
raj: On it. Will post patch and canary plan in the thread when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
